regions.name: Southwest (Yoruba)
visual_identifiers: specific Lagos bridge and island infrastructure

state_distinguishers.Lagos: Yellow danfo buses — most distinctive identifier in Nigeria, massive coastal megacity, Third Mainland Bridge infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Ibadan: Second largest city, specific Ibadan urban feel, less coastal

regions.route_sign_clues: Lagos-Ibadan Expressway very distinctive. Green Nigerian highway signs.
regions.gemini_hint: Yellow danfo minibuses = Lagos confirmed. Massive coastal megacity = Lagos. Tropical forest with Nigerian signage = Southwest.
common_false_positives: Tropical forest — shared with south Nigeria

regions.name: Southeast (Igbo)

state_distinguishers.Anambra: Onitsha largest market in Africa, Niger River crossing infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Enugu: Coal mining history, more hilly terrain

regions.gemini_hint: Niger River crossing + huge market = Onitsha/Anambra. Hilly terrain in southern Nigeria = Southeast.

regions.name: North Nigeria

state_distinguishers.Kano: Ancient walled city infrastructure, Kano City historic center, most populous northern city
state_distinguishers.Borno: Lake Chad proximity, most remote northeastern feel

regions.route_sign_clues: Abuja-Kano Expressway. Arabic script on some signs in north.
regions.gemini_hint: Mud brick architecture + Islamic style + Sahel = Northern Nigeria. Ancient walled city = Kano. Arabic script + very dry = far north.
common_false_positives: Sahel savanna — shared with Niger, Chad, Mali across border

regions.name: Federal Capital and Middle Belt
visual_identifiers: rocky plateau terrain in Jos area

state_distinguishers.Abuja_FCT: Planned city — very wide roads, modern government buildings, specific Abuja roundabout infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Plateau: Jos Plateau high altitude, cooler climate than surrounding areas, rocky terrain

regions.route_sign_clues: Abuja has very specific planned city road infrastructure.
regions.gemini_hint: Very wide planned roads + modern government buildings = Abuja FCT. Rocky high plateau = Jos/Plateau State. Niger-Benue river confluence area = Kogi.
common_false_positives: Transition vegetation — between north and south Nigeria
